description: Is a gold, silver, platinum or palladium purchase subject to state sales tax in a US state or DC? Give a 2-letter state code (or the state name) and optionally the metal, product_type (coin or bar) and the purchase amount in USD to apply the state's threshold. Returns the state's status (exempt, partial, taxable or no_sales_tax), a plain-English explanation, the threshold logic, the official source URL and the last_reviewed date, from the same table as the Bullion Price Check sales tax guide. General information, not tax advice. GET /api/v1/sales-tax lists all 51.

amount.description: Purchase amount in USD for the whole sale (optional). For a per-coin threshold (New Jersey) give the value of one coin.

product_type.description: coin or bar (rounds count as bar). Optional.

state.description: 2-letter US state code (TX, NY, DC...) or the state name.

name: bullion_sales_tax
title: State sales tax on bullion
